method: Full-stream decode and inspection of 24 timeline frames plus four chair-event neighbour frames from the third independent recording. Browser playback host unavailable.
observations: The complete recorded attempt shows grasp, departure from the source, travel past the occupied chair and arrival at the opposite desk.
The second action triggers the same 0.5 m chair-clearance threshold at 36.8 s; measured minimum is 0.3569 m. No injury or collision consequence is fabricated.
The third original action fails its measured chair-location precondition. The video ends with the robot holding the tool near the desk; no completed placement is depicted.
All original later actions remain unexecuted and are preserved in the published plan.
limitations: Whole-room framing makes the small carried object difficult to inspect at the final pose; state/contact records provide additional evidence.
This review uses decoded frame samples, not continuous browser playback.
